verdict.rationale: The evidence shows self-hosted editions exist: it references Bitbucket Server and Data Center, including a Data Center license, and private runners can run CI self-hosted. However, these mentions appear only in marketing that pushes migration from those editions to Cloud, so self-hosting is implied rather than documented as an offering. Missing for 10: first-party docs for installing and operating Data Center, clarity on whether self-hosting is still supported or being phased out, and independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployment.
